Spectyra 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Save on LLM and OpenClaw usage costs with the Spectyra Local Companion app.
- Automatic optimization for every OpenClaw scenario using a spectyra/* model: chat, local agents, scheduled/cron tasks, skills, and multi-step tool runs.
- Simple setup: install skill and npm package, run setup wizard, and start the local dashboard to view estimated savings and token metrics.
- Compatible with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Groq; works out-of-the-box for Spectyra model aliases (smart, fast, quality).
- Transparent pricing: 14-day full-featured free trial, then $4.99/month for continued access.
- 10% of all profits support AI safety organizations.
